Add `specs/private-repo-public-mirror/spec.md`: the researched decision record and migration plan for moving mngr development to a new private source-of-truth repository while keeping `imbue-ai/mngr` public as a filtered open-source mirror (Copybara hub-and-spoke: allowlist export, community-PR import, bot-only public main, private CI/release pipeline, tag re-pointing, cutover sequence, and leak/drift guardrails).

Add `mirror/`: the milestone-1 sync machinery — `copy.bara.sky` (one-way ITERATIVE export from `imbue-ai/mngr-internal` to `imbue-ai/mngr`, allowlist-filtered with every synced lib enumerated individually), `validate_sync.sh` (end-to-end validation against throwaway local repos, with exact-tree assertions derived from the config and a guard that refuses to run against non-local URLs), and `README.md` (operational runbook, the copybara rule-API reference for boundary reviews, and the explicit enable-blocker list). The sync is validated locally but not yet enabled; nothing changes on the public repo. Per the 2026-07-22 CTO decision, `apps/minds` is in the public allowlist (minus its deployment-testing subtrees); deployment/infra apps (`modal_litellm`, `remote_service_connector`) and `slack_exporter` stay private.

Prepare the remaining cutover machinery: `scripts/release.py` now refreshes the public-mirror overlay inside the release commit (advances the overlay `exclude-newer` cutoff and regenerates `mirror/overlay/uv.lock` from a temporary-ref snapshot of the working tree; the pinned copybara jar auto-downloads with checksum verification), `.github/workflows/mirror-push.yml` runs the export dispatch-only behind a confirmation phrase with a `--dry-run` default, and `mirror/pypi_trusted_publishers.md` lists the 37 PyPI projects needing a private-repo trusted publisher.

Harden the sync machinery after a second adversarial audit: a `core.verify_match` backstop makes unterminated `BEGIN-INTERNAL` blocks abort the sync instead of leaking, the `#N` message rewrite gains a left-context guard (idempotent; fully-qualified `imbue-ai/mngr#N` passes through as the deliberate public-issue-closure mechanism), the public justfile parses standalone (the `dwt-worktree` alias moves next to its private recipe), the slim public CI excludes `unison`-marked tests and validates the committed lock with `uv sync --locked`, and a new `Mirror gate` workflow materializes the public tree on every PR to catch overlay-lock drift and buildability breaks. The release-flow overlay refresh (regenerating the overlay lock inside the release commit) is tracked as an explicit enable blocker.

Clear the sync enable blockers and add the cutover rehearsal: the justfile is split into a public `justfile` plus ops-only `private.just` (optional import; identical recipe set), `mirror/overlay/` supplies the public-only root `pyproject.toml`, generated public `uv.lock`, and a slim public CI, commit messages are scrubbed on export (`INTERNAL:` sections deleted, `#N` references rewritten to inert `mngr-internal#N`, `BEGIN-INTERNAL`/`END-INTERNAL` file blocks stripped), `scripts/release.py` writes a `RELEASE_TAG` trailer that creates the matching tag on the mirror, and `mirror/materialize_public_tree.sh` + `mirror/rehearse_cutover.sh` materialize the filtered tree and rehearse the entire cutover flow (including public-tree buildability) against throwaway local repos.
